rationale: Pivot away from the exhausted PR1612 hyperparameter lane into a new architecture category. This keeps the current quant-aware / projection-EMA endgame intact, adds one compile-stable extra pass through the final block using a learned gated delta for shared-weight effective depth at negligible size cost, and makes scalar optimizer selection robust for new top-level control tensors while removing the unused num_skip_weights attribute.
title: Tail-Block Gated Recurrence On Best Quant Path
